litigation.mdlName: In re: Social Media Adolescent Addiction/Personal Injury Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Northern District of California

phase: Meta settled the state attorneys general track; individual and school-district claims continue
phaseDetail: On August 26, 2026, Meta settled the state attorneys general claims during trial: at least $12.1 billion to the states, rising to $17.1 billion if other major social media companies reach similar state settlements, plus design changes for users under 18. The funds go to states, not individuals or school districts, and Meta did not admit liability. Individual personal-injury claims, school-district claims and claims against TikTok, Snap and YouTube continue; the separate California JCCP is a different proceeding.

settlements.detail: Announced August 26, 2026. Meta pays at least $12.1 billion to the coalition states, increasing to $17.1 billion if other major social media companies reach similar settlements with states, and agrees to design changes for users under 18. Meta did not admit liability.
settlements.individualClaims: Does not pay individual families or school districts and does not resolve personal-injury claims.

settlements.individualClaims: Outcomes in government cases do not determine what an individual claimant may receive.

updates.summary: Meta settled the state attorneys general claims on August 26, 2026: at least $12.1 billion to states, up to $17.1 billion if other major platforms reach similar state settlements. Funds go to states; individual and school-district claims continue.
JPML reports 3,824 pending actions in MDL-3047 on October 1, 2026, up 616 from 3,208 on September 1; 4,009 total historical actions are reported separately.
JPML reports 3,208 pending actions on September 1, 2026, compared with 3,137 on August 3; 3,383 total historical actions are reported separately.
The court-linked calendar lists February 8, 2027 for the school-district bellwether jury trial, with jury selection February 3.
The same calendar lists the state attorneys general trial against Meta from August 17, 2026; that schedule is separate from an individual injury trial.
The federal court’s September 8 recent filings list conditional transfer order CTO-87, confirming continuing MDL transfers.
